name_reason: Follows data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=audio). Descriptor accurately describes the role: a lookup table mapping a FIGANI SFX-bank reference byte to an FDOTHER.DAT entry index. Reflects the data type via the 'lut' suffix. No Ghidra address residue (no hex tail equal to its own/another address). Correct as-is.
purpose: Read-only 6-byte translation table that maps a FIGANI header's SFX-bank reference byte (1-based) to the FDOTHER.DAT entry index of the actual SFX bank resource.
logic_summary: Sole consumer fd2_load_figani_sfx_bank (0x2bc9a) block-copies the 6 bytes onto an 8-byte stack local (MOVSD+MOVSW from MOV ESI,0x525d6), reads sfx_id_byte = figani_data[+4], and if non-zero indexes 1-based: fdother_idx = lut[sfx_id_byte - 1] (disasm MOVZX EAX, byte ptr [ESP + EAX*1 - 1]). The fetched byte is passed as the entry index to fd2_load_dat_resource("FDOTHER.DAT", 0, fdother_idx), loading that resource as the animation's SFX bank.
element_semantics: Each byte is an FDOTHER.DAT entry index. Values are {0x30,0x31,0x32,0x33,0x34,0x35} (decimal 48..53), one per valid 1-based FIGANI SFX-bank reference id (1..6). Unsigned, stride 1; read via MOVZX.
notes: Data plate at 0x525d6 was empty (PLATE=null); created a concise ASCII plate via run_script_inline + cu.setComment(PLATE_COMMENT,...) reflecting the src conclusion (verified WROTE_OK=true). src comment block (audtab.c lines 48-61) was already accurate, precise and ASCII-clean, so audtab.c is unchanged (comment kept). Only xrefs to the data are READ + DATA (the MOV ESI source) from fd2_load_figani_sfx_bank; zero writers anywhere -> is_const=true. Datatype byte[6] confirmed via Ghidra getDataAt. Address not present in fd2-knowledge strategy-guide offsets (internal animation/audio table, expected).
